notes: Fish Audio S2-Pro (4.56B) from fishaudio/s2-pro, pinned at revision 1de9996b, run through fish-speech pinned at commit 541566932. The repo is not gated, so no HF_TOKEN is needed. The shim encodes the reference clips once at start on the CPU, then decodes in bf16. It uses about 14.5 GB of VRAM at peak with the context capped at 8192, so it runs on the 16 GB card only. The card's cue tags are passed to the model as plain text. Output is 44.1 kHz. The server exits after 20 seconds idle, so each render after that pays about 35 seconds to load the model. GPU only.
